execution.routing_restart_reason: LibreLane 3.1.0.dev3 passed -threads None to OpenROAD when OPENROAD_THREADS was unset, leaving detailed routing at roughly one CPU; the first attempt was stopped during detail routing and restarted from the completed pre-route checkpoint with six threads.

outcome: The inferred 64x32 store fits and routes in 6x4, but the predeclared 20 ns pass criterion is refuted by one slow-corner setup violation; full GDS/DRC/LVS signoff remains open.
next_decision: Proceed with the standard-cell store. Run a separately locked clock-period experiment, starting at 25 ns with explicit I/O constraints, and repair the slow-corner slew/fanout violations before PE-10 closure. A 25 ns timing pass is an inference from this run, not yet measured.
